{{Top|leg}}
A '''battle tab''' was a type of uniform decoration that was sewn onto the left sleeve of a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]]. These tabs indicated the battles that a given pilot participated in, and were usually uniquely decorated to reflect the particular battle they represented, or circumstances within the battle that made the participant stand out. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] pilot [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] was known to have worn battle tabs on his flight suit for the Battles of [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Endor]], [[Invasion of Bakura|Bakura]], and [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Coruscant]], with the tab for Endor bearing a black dot that signified his run through the second [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]].
